def plan_clicks(frame, prefer=None):
    rows,cols,cells,legend = analyze(frame)
    palette=[c for _,c in legend]
    cons={}
    for (r,c),v in cells.items():

        for di in range(3):
            for dj in range(3):
                if di==1 and dj==1: continue
                ch=blk[di][dj]
                if ch not in 'Wg': continue
                key=(r+(di-1)*8, c+(dj-1)*8)
                if key not in cells: continue
                cons.setdefault(key,[]).append((own, ch=='W'))
    cycle = palette  # b->R->O->b  (legend order == cycle order, verified b->R->O->b)
    idx={c:i for i,c in enumerate(cycle)}
    actions=[]; chosen={}
    for key,lst in sorted(cons.items()):
        cur = cells[key][1]
        ok=[col for col in palette if all(((col==own) if same else (col!=own)) for own,same in lst)]
        if not ok: return None,None
        best = min(ok, key=lambda col: (idx[col]-idx[cur])%len(cycle))

        for _ in range(n):
            actions.append({'action':'MOUSE','row':key[0]+3,'col':key[1]+3})
